metadata.title: 💬Money Quote: Nvidia’s Kress Seeks to Reassure on Demand

content.text:
LIVE
Just In
💬Money Quote: Nvidia’s Kress Seeks to Reassure on Demand
📣 “The most important thing that we have been seeing is just, again, a continued growth in the demand that’s out there.”
—Nvidia’s interim CEO Colette Kress, speaking to CNBC after the company reported record-breaking revenue in her first interview since Jensen Huang's exit.
